verdicts.reason: A keeps the dark header band, logo, eyebrow-over-headline order and a sensible two-column banner layout. It still has flaws: the orange divider is stranded under the headline, the right column (body copy, CTA, 'Ships late June') floats high with no shared top edge, and a large dead band sits between the content and the footer legal text. B breaks the reading order. The 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow drops to the bottom-left, below the headline it should introduce. The header becomes a random dark block in the corner with the divider left floating beneath it. The body copy is larger than the CTA, and 'Reserve a Case' is a tiny button. The legal text is squeezed into a narrow, unreadable column wedged beside the CTA and under the detached 'Ships late June'.
